heroSubtitle: An exclusive residential enclave in Manipal Hill, Adjacent to Manipal Lake, Manipal, Karnataka 576104 featuring panoramic views, signature clubhouse, and world-class amenities.
editorialStory:
Rising gracefully in Manipal Hill, Adjacent to Manipal Lake, Manipal, Karnataka 576104, Grasslands Lakeside redefines architectural luxury in Kochi. Developed by Grasslands Developers, this landmark enclave balances pristine biophilic landscaping with world-class residential comforts.

Every home is crafted with oversized viewing balconies, cross-ventilating breezy layouts, and premium specifications designed for discerning families and global investors.

Life revolves around an exclusive lifestyle clubhouse featuring resort swimming pools, wellness spa pavilions, sports arenas, and 24/7 five-tier security for absolute peace of mind.
